result.description:
The Northern Beaches Council is a recent LGA on Sydney's northern beaches formed from the merger of Manly, Pittwater and Warringah councils. 

http://www.northernbeaches.nsw.gov.au/

Flood Studies, Plans and Maps available:
http://www.pittwater.nsw.gov.au/property/natural_hazards/flooding/where_does_it_flood/flood_studies_and_plans

Careel Creek
Avalon to Palm Beach Flood Risk Management Study and Plan - current project.
Careel Creek Catchment Flood Study - July 2013
Careel Creek Floodplain Risk Management Plan November 2002 
Careel Creek Floodplain Management Study Sept 2000 
Careel Creek Drainage Catchment Flood Study June 1999 - superseded

Great Mackerel Beach
Great Mackerel Beach Floodplain Risk Management Study and Plan - November 2010
Great Mackerel Beach Flood Study September 2005

Mona Vale/Bayview
McCarrs Creek, Mona Vale and Bayview Flood Study - current project
Mona Vale - Bayview Flood Study May 2002

Narrabeen Lagoon
Narrabeen Lagoon Flood Study - September 2013
Narrabeen Lagoon Floodplain Risk Management Plan Vol 1 Pittwater December 2002
Narrabeen Lagoon Floodplain Management Study 1992

Nareen Creek (subcatchment of Narrabeen Lagoon)
Nareen Creek Flood Study September 2005 - superseded

Warriewood Valley (subcatchment of Narrabeen Lagoon)
Warriewood Valley Flood Study April 2005 - superseded
Warriewood Valley Flood Study Addendum 1 July 2005 - superseded
Warriewood Valley Urban Land Release Water Management  Specification - February 2001

Newport
Newport Beach Floodplain Risk Management Study & Plan February 2004
Newport Beach Flood Study March 2002

Other Areas
Pittwater Overland Flow Mapping and Flood Study - October 2013
McCarrs Creek, Mona Vale and Bayview Flood Study - current project
Avalon to Palm Beach Flood Risk Management Study and Plan - current project
